exercises.name: Marching in Place
exercises.instructions: Lift knees high at a gentle march pace, swinging arms naturally to warm up the whole body.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instructions: Extend arms out to the sides and draw slow, controlled circles, small at first, then larger.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.instructions: Shift weight onto one leg and circle the other ankle slowly each direction, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding the spine slowly, breathing with each move.

exercises.name: Standing Side Bend
exercises.instructions: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side, feeling a stretch along the waist.

exercises.name: Slow Plié Squat (no weight)
exercises.instructions: Feet wide, toes turned out, lower a few inches and rise slowly to wake up the legs.

exercises.name: Plié Squat
exercises.instructions: Stand wide with toes turned out. Bend the knees straight over the toes, chest lifted, then squeeze the glutes to rise.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions: Feet hip-width apart, sit the hips back and down as if into a chair, then drive through the heels to stand.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step one leg back and lower until both knees are at soft right angles, then push off the back foot to return.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes to lift the hips, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Standing Side Leg Lift
exercises.instructions: Holding onto something stable if needed, lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Arabesque Leg Lift
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward slightly from the hips and extend one leg straight behind you, like a ballet arabesque, keeping the spine long.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step one leg diagonally behind the other, crossing slightly, and lower into a curtsy before returning to standing.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: From a glute bridge position, extend one leg straight and lift the hips using only the grounded leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest and squat down between the knees, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Holding a dumbbell in each hand, hinge at the hips with a soft knee bend, lowering the weights along your shins, then squeeze glutes to stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.instructions: Holding light dumbbells, step one foot onto a sturdy step or bench and drive up through that heel, then step back down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Upper back braced on a bench or the floor, dumbbell resting on your hips, drive through the heels to lift the hips, squeezing the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Holding a dumbbell in each hand, step forward into a lunge, then bring the back leg through into the next step.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Walk
exercises.instructions: With a loop band around the ankles or thighs, bend the knees slightly and step sideways, keeping tension on the band.

exercises.name: Band Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions: With a band around the ankles on all fours, kick one leg straight back and squeeze the glute, then return with control.

exercises.name: Band Squat
exercises.instructions: Stand on a loop band with ends held at the shoulders, and squat down and up against the band's resistance.

exercises.name: Band Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width, holding the ends at your hips, and hinge forward with a soft knee bend, then squeeze glutes to rise.

exercises.name: Band Static Lunge
exercises.instructions: Stand on the band in a split stance, holding the ends at your shoulders, and lower into a lunge, then press back up.

exercises.name: Band Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Loop the band above your knees, upper back braced on a bench, and drive the hips up, pressing the knees out against the band.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar resting across the upper back, feet shoulder-width. Sit the hips back and down, keeping the chest tall, then drive up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower the sled with control until knees reach about 90 degrees, then press back up.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions: Ankle cuff attached to the low cable, kick one leg straight back and squeeze the glute, then return with control.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge with Barbell
exercises.instructions: Bar across the upper back, step forward into a lunge, then bring the back leg through into the next step.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Upper back braced on a bench, bar across the hips, drive through the heels to lift the hips, squeezing the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Holding the bar at your hips, hinge forward with a soft knee bend, lowering the bar along your shins, then squeeze glutes to stand tall.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Standing Leg Lift
exercises.instructions: With ankle weights on, lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee, then lower slowly. Switch sides.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Donkey Kick
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees with ankle weights on, kick one leg up and back, squeezing the glute at the top, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Fire Hydrant
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees with ankle weights on, lift one knee out to the side, keeping it bent, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Leg Circles
exercises.instructions: Lying on your side with ankle weights on, draw slow circles with your top leg, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Reverse Lunge
exercises.instructions: With ankle weights on, step one leg back and lower until both knees are at soft right angles, then push off the back foot to return.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Standing Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Seated or standing with ankle weights on, straighten one knee out in front of you, squeezing the quad, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Standing Hamstring Curl
exercises.instructions: Standing with ankle weights on, kick one heel up toward the glute, squeezing the hamstring, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Glute Bridge March
exercises.instructions: With ankle weights on, lift into a glute bridge and hold, then march the knees up one at a time without dropping the hips.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on forearms and toes, bracing the stomach gently.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lying on your back, arms and knees lifted, slowly extend one arm and the opposite leg, keeping your lower back still.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lying on your back, bring opposite elbow to opposite knee in a slow pedalling motion, keeping the lower back grounded.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, extend one arm and the opposite leg straight, holding a steady line, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Seated with knees bent and torso leaned back slightly, rotate the torso side to side with control.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.instructions: Lying on your back, lift shoulders and legs slightly off the floor, pressing the lower back down, and hold.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Balance on one forearm and the side of one foot, hips lifted in a straight line, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Pilates Hundred
exercises.instructions: Lying on your back with legs lifted and head/shoulders curled up, pump the arms up and down in small beats.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Hold a light dumbbell at your chest in the Russian Twist position and rotate side to side with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: Holding a light dumbbell at your chest, lie back with knees bent and curl all the way up to sitting, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Band Dead Bug Pull
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold both ends while performing a dead bug, pulling the band straight down as you extend each leg.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchopper
exercises.instructions: Cable set high, pull the handle diagonally across your body down to the opposite hip, rotating through the torso with control.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.instructions: Hanging from a bar, lift the knees toward the chest with control, then lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneeling below a high cable, curl the torso down toward the thighs, exhaling and contracting the abs.

exercises.name: Ab Machine Crunch
exercises.instructions: Seated in the ab machine, curl forward against the resistance, squeezing the abs, then return with control.

exercises.name: Ankle Weight Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: With ankle weights on, lie on your back and slowly extend one arm and the opposite leg, keeping your lower back still.

exercises.name: Wall Angel
exercises.instructions: Back against a wall, arms bent at the sides, slide the arms up and down the wall keeping contact for posture and shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, lift the arms, chest and legs slightly off the floor and hold, squeezing the back muscles.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: From a plank, lower the chest toward the floor with elbows at a 45-degree angle, then press back up. Drop to the knees for an easier version.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip
exercises.instructions: Hands on a sturdy chair or step behind you, bend the elbows to lower the hips, then press back up.

exercises.name: Towel Bicep Curl
exercises.instructions: Step on one end of a towel and grip the other end, then curl your hand toward your shoulder against the tension, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.instructions: Holding a dumbbell in each hand, curl the weights toward the shoulders keeping elbows tucked in, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward slightly, elbows bent at your sides, and extend the forearms straight back, then return with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Holding light dumbbells, raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Holding dumbbells at shoulder height, press both weights straight overhead, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding a dumbbell in each hand, and pull both elbows back, squeezing the shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.instructions: Hold a band at chest height with arms extended, and pull it apart by squeezing the shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Band Row
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band in front of you and pull both ends toward your waist, squeezing the shoulder blades at the end.

exercises.name: Band Bicep Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand on the middle of the band, holding an end in each hand, and curl both hands toward your shoulders, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band overhead, elbows tucked at your sides, and push the ends down until arms are straight, then return with control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Grip the bar wide, pull it down toward the upper chest, squeezing the shoulder blades, then let it rise with control.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Elbows tucked at your sides, push the bar down until arms are straight, then return with control.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sitting tall, pull the handle toward your waist, squeezing the shoulder blades together, then extend back with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Bar at shoulder height, press it straight overhead until arms are extended, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl
exercises.instructions: Standing at the low cable with a straight bar attachment, curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.instructions: Holding onto something stable, pull one heel toward the glutes, keeping knees close together, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
exercises.instructions: Sitting with legs extended, hinge forward from the hips over the legs, letting the back round softly.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.instructions: Kneel and fold forward, reaching the arms out ahead and sitting the hips back toward the heels.

exercises.name: Chest Opener Stretch
exercises.instructions: Clasp both hands behind your back and gently lift, opening across the chest and shoulders.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch
exercises.instructions: Lying on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and gently pull the leg in toward your chest.
